propositions: Data Center outbound status changes are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=status) instead of being routed through transition_issue_by_name, causing status to be silently rejected since status is not an editable field in Jira

The Cloud transport correctly pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue_by_name, but the Data Center transport lacks this routing and instead includes status in the fields dict passed to issue.update()
JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue must pop status from kwargs and route it through transition_issue_by_name to resolve the destination status name to the correct workflow transition
Illegal transitions from the current workflow state must remain non-fatal and produce observable bridge alert records rather than failing silently or aborting the batch
The outbound transition routing fix must preserve the existing field-edit path for other allowlisted fields like assignee in the same update_issue call
